body: Review at d63cf03f39. (1) BLOCKING, statusline latency: each render spawns rev-parse + ls-tree + one 'git cat-file blob' PER regen/trials record (controls included, unbounded). Fix: cache the summary keyed by store HEAD SHA (an unchanged HEAD means zero git calls), and on a miss read the blobs with ONE 'git cat-file --batch'. (2) summary() must filter completed_at <= until (digest --until currently shows a future score as age 0s). (3) Compact age (14d/3h/12m), not raw seconds. Tests: the until filter; the cached statusline path spawns no cat-file; non-clean and flagged as separate cases. Targeted tests plus check-ci-fast/compile. Push and mail me the head. Keep going on STORY-1676 in parallel only if it doesn't share files.
